desc:
Welcome to JUST ONE MORE ASYM.

JOMA is an asymmetrical game with a juggernaut-style spin on it. One AI controlled killer and their player controlled cohorts hunting down 13 survivors.

You can either run and survive, or stand your ground and *eliminate what's hunting you in the first place in this 4v13 half-asym half-juggernaut.

ABERRANT | The AI controlled killer. Usually the main threat and very lethal, although very predictable.
ADVERSARY | The chosen sub-killers that protect the main killer. Ranging from supports to attackers, use the AI to your advantage,
SURVIVORS | Run for your life, but if the situation calls for it, stand your ground instead.

Game mostly inspired by random Roblox asymmetrical horror games, though otherwise sticks to mostly original content.

[ GAME RULES : ]
1. No Exploiting
2. No Intentional Bug Abuse
